description: Fishing forecast (solunar + NWS) — Fishing outlook for a US location for 1-7 days: solunar major periods (moon overhead/underfoot +/-1h) and minor periods (moonrise/moonset +/-30min) from an offline moon ephemeris, moon phase and illumination, sunrise/sunset overlap, NWS hourly wind / rain / thunderstorms and the nearest station's barometer trend (falling, steady, rising). Each day gets EXCELLENT/GOOD/FAIR/POOR, a score, best times and reasons. Params: lat, lon, days=1-7 (default 3). Times are local. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_fishing
